title: The complete massless singlet spectrum in the free-field construction of heterotic strings on Calabi--Yau orbifolds
summary: We apply the free-field construction of the heterotic string compactified on Berglund--Hübsch Calabi--Yau orbifolds by computing the full spectrum of massless $E_6$ singlets. The contribution of the descendant vertices is obtained by combining the exact content of the irreducible $N=2$ minimal model representations, encoded in the ranks of the Shapovalov matrices, with the twisted sector structure of the orbifold.
